assumptions: All path matching (/adam/, /cdap_, _anon_, ia prefix, etc.) is case-sensitive, except the 'ar' folder name in CDAR which is compared in lowercase.
Matching is done on the folder path with incoming/ removed, so the study folder is part of the path.
In the CDAP interim rule 'ia' + rest means the two-letter prefix ia is removed from the third part and re-added as ia_ (ia300 -> ia_300).
Rule 5 and rule 6 both match a path with /data_reuse/ and /cdar/ plus a data format, so such files go to error/ (as in the document example).
Files that match the skip rules are left untouched in incoming/ and not reported.
Delivery is a move, so it needs a custom S3 delivery step (server-side copy, check, delete, tagging); source and destination bucket are set per environment.
